name: fq_end_and_search2
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'sources/fqsym-raw.txt').read_text();print(s[55000:57600]);print(s[39000:42400]);print(s[:5000])
plan={'queries':['"Keller" "Pilpel" influences Christofides conjecture','"Hou" "linear Kneser" conjecture proved inseparable','"Cotterill" "indegree" Shin Zeng conjecture']}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'search2-plan.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),str(p/'search2-plan.json')],text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout);assert r.returncode==0
